Implemented Section 4 (Health/HealthKit):

- **`modules/expo-health/`** — new local Expo module (Swift) wrapping HealthKit for step count: `getAuthorizationStatus`, `requestAuthorization` (read+write), `saveSteps`, and `getDailySteps` (per-day cumulative sums via `HKStatisticsQuery`, all sources). Podspec links the `HealthKit` framework.
- **`app.json`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` and the `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement.
- **`screens/HealthScreen.tsx`** — wired to the module: status line reflects sharing authorization and refreshes on focus (`useFocusEffect`), `Request Access` requests auth, `Log 500 Steps` (enabled only when authorized) saves a sample and reloads the list, and the Last 7 Days list renders exactly 7 rows (`Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps`, today suffixed `(today)`, en-US thousands separators), showing `Health access needed` when not authorized. Errors from native calls surface directly in the status line.

Verified with `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the full build command — `xcodebuild ... build` → **BUILD SUCCEEDED**, no errors/warnings in the new Swift module.
